interface.longDescription: Ordinary conversation with intellectual discipline. Start with an idea, question, or decision. Dialectical helps clarify claims, surface prior art and connections, compare competing explanations, test assumptions, and seek disconfirming evidence. Its focused operations are optional; conversation remains primary. This skills-only plugin requires no external service. Research uses available evidence tools; continuity uses the current chat or notes you supply, with optional file storage when authorized.
defaultPrompt: Find prior art connected to this idea.
Use ACH to compare these explanations.
Run a thought experiment on this claim.
